components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Top-bar tool link. Muted at rest, Off-White on hover, Arc Blue when active.
components.html: ItemsMap
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:2px; padding:8px 12px; background:color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-bg) 92%, transparent); backdrop-filter:blur(12px); border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-border); } .ds-nav-link { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:6px; text-decoration:none; color:var(--color-muted); font-family:'Figtree',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:13px; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:0.01em; transition:color 0.12s ease-out, background 0.12s ease-out; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color:var(--color-text); background:var(--color-surface); } .ds-nav-link.is-active { color:var(--color-accent); background:color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-accent) 8%, transparent); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Pill Tabs
components.description: Canonical segmented control for builder panels. Mono uppercase; active tab takes Arc Blue.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display:inline-flex; gap:2px; padding:3px; background:var(--color-surface); border:1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius:8px; } .ds-tabs button { background:transparent; border:0; border-radius:5px; color:var(--color-muted); padding:6px 14px; cursor:pointer; font:600 12px/1 'Geist Mono','Courier New',monospace; letter-spacing:0.08em; text-transform:uppercase; transition:color 0.12s ease-out, background 0.12s ease-out; } .ds-tabs button:hover { color:var(--color-text); } .ds-tabs button.on { color:var(--color-accent); background:color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-accent) 8%, transparent); } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Toggleable filter chip. Ghost border at rest; Arc Blue text + border + tint when on.
components.css: .ds-fgroup { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px; } .ds-fgroup button { background:transparent; border:1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius:4px; color:var(--color-muted); font-family:'Figtree',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:12px; padding:4px 8px; cursor:pointer; text-transform:capitalize; transition:color 0.12s ease-out, border-color 0.12s ease-out, background 0.12s ease-out; } .ds-fgroup button:hover { color:var(--color-text); border-color:var(--color-faint); } .ds-fgroup button.on { color:var(--color-accent); border-color:var(--color-accent); background:color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-accent) 8%, transparent); } .ds-fgroup button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Filter Input
components.description: Search / filter text field. Border shifts to Arc Blue on focus, no glow.
components.css: .ds-input { background:var(--color-surface); border:1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius:6px; padding:8px 10px; color:var(--color-text); font-family:'Figtree',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:13px; transition:border-color 0.12s ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:var(--color-muted); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:none; border-color:var(--color-accent); }

components.name: Tool Row
components.description: Landing-page tool entry. Borderless row, not a boxed card; everything shifts to Arc Blue on hover and the arrow nudges right.
components.html: BuildBuilderCreate and plan builds→
components.css: .ds-toolgroup { display:flex; flex-direction:column; } .ds-group-rule { font:500 11px/1 'Geist Mono','Courier New',monospace; letter-spacing:0.1em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--color-faint); padding-bottom:10px; } .ds-tool-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:auto auto 1fr auto; align-items:center; gap:14px; padding:14px 4px; border-top:1px solid var(--color-border); text-decoration:none; color:var(--color-text); } .ds-tool-ico, .ds-tool-arrow { color:var(--color-faint); transition:color 0.12s ease-out, transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-tool-name { font-family:'Barlow Semi Condensed',system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:16px; } .ds-tool-desc { font-family:'Figtree',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:13px; color:var(--color-muted); } .ds-tool-arrow { font-size:15px; } .ds-tool-row:hover .ds-tool-name, .ds-tool-row:hover .ds-tool-ico, .ds-tool-row:hover .ds-tool-arrow { color:var(--color-accent); } .ds-tool-row:hover .ds-tool-arrow { transform:translateX(3px); } .ds-tool-row:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Range Slider
components.description: Filter range slider. Seam track, accent/70 range fill, accent-bordered thumb on the page ground.
components.css: .ds-slider { position:relative; display:flex; align-items:center; width:220px; padding-block:6px; } .ds-slider-track { position:relative; height:4px; width:100%; border-radius:9999px; background:var(--color-border); overflow:hidden; } .ds-slider-range { position:absolute; left:0; height:100%; width:62%; background:color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-accent) 70%, transparent); } .ds-slider-thumb { position:absolute; left:60%; height:14px; width:14px; border-radius:9999px; border:1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-accent) 60%, transparent); background:var(--color-bg); box-shadow:0 1px 4px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.3); cursor:grab; } .ds-slider-thumb:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-accent) 50%, transparent); border-color:var(--color-accent); }

components.name: Page CTA
components.description: Mono uppercase ghost CTA in toolbars. Arc Blue text inside a low-opacity accent border.
components.css: .ds-cta { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; font:600 11px/1 'Geist Mono','Courier New',monospace; letter-spacing:0.08em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--color-accent); text-decoration:none; padding:6px 12px; border:1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-accent) 35%, transparent); border-radius:6px; transition:border-color 0.12s ease-out, background 0.12s ease-out; } .ds-cta:hover { border-color:var(--color-accent); background:color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-accent) 6%, transparent); } .ds-cta:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Floating Panel
components.description: Shared pattern for nav dropdowns, map filter panels, and search results: blurred translucent surface, accent/20 ring, Float shadow.
components.css: .ds-panel { width:200px; background:color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-surface) 96%, transparent); backdrop-filter:blur(12px); border:1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-accent) 20%, transparent); border-radius:8px; padding:4px; box-shadow:0 4px 24px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.3); display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:2px; } .ds-panel-kicker { font:500 11px/1 'Geist Mono','Courier New',monospace; letter-spacing:0.1em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--color-faint); padding:6px 10px 4px; } .ds-panel-row { padding:8px 10px; border-radius:6px; color:var(--color-muted); font-family:'Figtree',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:13px; cursor:pointer; transition:color 0.12s ease-out, background 0.12s ease-out; } .ds-panel-row:hover { color:var(--color-text); background:var(--color-surface-hi); } .ds-panel-row--on { color:var(--color-accent); background:color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-accent) 8%, transparent); }

components.name: In-Game Tooltip

Pixel fonts, pure #0d0d0d ground, per-rarity pixel-art frame, hardcoded rarity hex. Theme-independent; the design system's tokens and type roles are intentionally suspended inside. Static Legendary example shown; in production the frame is a per-rarity border-image sprite.

components.css: .ds-tt { position:relative; width:340px; font-family:'wynncraft','Geist Mono',monospace; letter-spacing:-1px; background:#0d0d0d; border:2px solid #55ffff; image-rendering:pixelated; } .ds-tt-inner { padding:20px 18px 14px; background:linear-gradient(#0d0d0df7, #081d5af7); margin:10px 8px 5px; color:#fcfcfc; } .ds-tt-name { font-size:26px; line-height:1; color:#55ffff; text-shadow:3px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.45); } .ds-tt-tags { display:flex; gap:5px; margin-top:6px; } .ds-tt-tag { color:#000; font-family:'wynn-five','wynn-default',monospace; font-size:16px; line-height:14px; padding:2px 6px; text-transform:lowercase; } .ds-tt-dps { display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:6px; margin-top:8px; } .ds-tt-dps-n { font-size:30px; color:#bef6f6; } .ds-tt-dps-u { font-size:18px; } .ds-tt-sep { height:2px; margin:12px auto 8px; background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#bef6f6 0 6px,transparent 6px 10px); opacity:0.7; } .ds-tt-ids { list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:3px; } .ds-tt-ids li { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr; align-items:baseline; gap:10px; font-size:17px; } .ds-tt-ids li span:first-child { text-align:left; } .ds-tt-ids li span:last-child { text-align:right; } .ds-tt-id-name { color:#fcfcfc; text-align:center; } .ds-tt-good { color:#83f7c6; } .ds-tt-bad { color:#f78383; } .ds-tt-lore { margin:10px 0 0; font-family:'wynn-ascii',monospace; font-size:16px; line-height:1.35; color:#aaaaaa; }

narrative.overview: wynn.tools is a precision instrument cooled to working temperature. The visual language is graphite under arc light: a dark, cool-cast ground (OKLCH hue 265, a near-neutral blue-grey) crossed by a single electric-blue accent (hue 245) that reads as cold light, not heat. Where the old system glowed copper like metal in a hearth, this one glows like a weld arc or an instrument LED: the readiness signal of a tool that has been calibrated rather than decorated. The display face is condensed and heavy because players parse stat tables fast; section labels, counts, and the logo are mono to mark them as system output; body copy is Figtree, legible without performing friendliness. The system is themeable from the ground up: every surface, tint, and glow resolves through --color-* tokens, so the same instrument re-lights cleanly across Dark, Midnight, and Light. It refuses RPG fantasy ornament, crypto-era maximalism, and generic SaaS calm.
keyCharacteristics: Cool graphite ground, electric-blue light — near-neutral hue-265 surfaces; one blue accent (hue 245) is the only color that truly illuminates
Token-driven theming — Dark / Midnight / Light all re-point the same --color-* names; components stay theme-agnostic
Condensed display weight over humanist body — authority and legibility at different scales
Mono for system output — counts, coordinates, section kickers, the logo: anything that reads as the machine talking
Flat at rest, blue glow on state change — depth is thermal and electric, never structural shadow at rest
Gold quarantined to the game world — item rarities and stat highlights only, never UI chrome

rules.name: The One Arc Rule
rules.body: Arc Blue appears on <=15% of any given screen. Its presence means interactive or selected. Using it as a decorative fill collapses the signal. When in doubt, use Muted and let the blue arrive on hover or focus.

rules.name: The No-Pure-Black/White Rule
rules.body: #000 and #fff are forbidden in every theme. Each neutral is tinted toward hue 265 (chroma 0.004-0.014). The Dark floor is Graphite Ground; the ceiling is Off-White.

rules.name: The Gold Quarantine Rule
rules.body: Ingot Gold is game-world only. It does not appear on buttons, links, focus rings, or any UI element. The same quarantine applies to the five element hues and to the eight in-game tooltip rarity colors.

rules.name: The Walled-Garden Rule
rules.body: The in-game tooltips are a sealed surface. Their pixel fonts, pure #0d0d0d ground, hardcoded rarity hex, and pixelated rendering live only inside the tooltip and never leak into the chrome; conversely, the --color-* tokens, Figtree/Barlow type, and theme system never reach inside the tooltip. The boundary is the point.

rules.name: The Token-Resolved Rule
rules.body: Never hardcode a neutral or accent value in a component. Reference --color-* so the element re-tints across Dark, Midnight, and Light. A literal oklch() neutral baked into a component is a theming bug.

rules.name: The Mono-for-System Rule
rules.body: Any text that reads as output from the system rather than communication to the user — counts, coordinates, section kickers, the logo — uses Geist Mono. Prose uses Figtree. Headings use Barlow Semi Condensed. These roles do not cross.

rules.name: The No-Decorative-Type Rule
rules.body: Barlow Semi Condensed ships at 600 minimum, 700-800 preferred. A condensed face at 300 weight is aesthetically incoherent with this system.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No element casts a shadow at rest. Shadows and glows are state responses — hover, focus, float — only. A surface that glows at rest is broken.

rules.name: The No-Lift Rule
rules.body: transform: translateY(-Xpx) is forbidden on hover for panels, cards, and rows. The permitted exception is a horizontal nudge (translateX(3px)) on a chevron or arrow.

dos: Do tint every neutral toward hue 265 and resolve it through a --color-* token so it re-tints across Dark, Midnight, and Light.
Do use Arc Blue only on interactive, selected, or focused elements (<=15% of a screen). If it appears decoratively at rest, remove it.
Do use Geist Mono for anything that reads as system output: counts, coordinates, section kickers, group rules, the logo.
Do use Barlow Semi Condensed at weight 600 minimum, 700-800 for hero and headings.
Do cap body line length at 65ch. Dense data UI does not mean dense reading columns.
Do reach for .tabs, .f-group, .f-input, .f-slider, and the kicker utility before hand-rolling a new variant of a control that already exists.
Do use backdrop-blur + a --color-* surface at 92-97% opacity with an accent/20 ring for every floating panel.
Do transition colors and background at 0.12-0.15s ease-out. Faster reads as broken; slower reads as laggy.
Do keep Wynnic decoration to the hero at <=5% opacity.
Do keep the in-game tooltips sealed: pixel fonts, pure #0d0d0d ground, per-rarity hex, and pixelated rendering stay inside the tooltip and render identically across all three themes.
Do put a 2px solid Arc Blue focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element, and kill all motion under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
donts: Don't use #000 or #fff in any theme. Pure black or white reads immediately as foreign on a hue-265 ground.
Don't hardcode a neutral or accent oklch() value in a component. That breaks theming — reference the token.
Don't use Ingot Gold or the element hues on UI chrome. They are game-world semantics — item rarities, stat highlights, elemental glyphs — never buttons, links, or focus rings.
Don't use a border-left (or border-right) greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards, rows, or callouts.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text with a gradient). Use solid Arc Blue; emphasize with weight or size.
Don't use glassmorphism decoratively. Backdrop-blur is structural — it belongs to floating panels in a layered environment, not to flat surfaces.
Don't use the hero-metric template (big number, small label, gradient accent). That is SaaS cliche territory.
Don't rebuild the landing tool rows as an identical icon-heading-text card grid. The borderless row with a trailing arrow is intentional.

Don't let the in-game tooltip aesthetic leak into the chrome (pixel fonts, #0d0d0d, rarity hex, pixelated edges) or apply --color-* tokens, the UI fonts, or the theme system inside a tooltip. The Walled-Garden boundary runs both ways.

Don't add parchment textures, medieval ornament, pixel art fonts, or anything that says 'this is a game' instead of 'this is a tool.' That is the hppeng-wynn / WynnData aesthetic this project replaces.
Don't use crypto/NFT visual language: neon on black, blurry hero gradients, vague hype copy ('the future of X'), orbital glows.
Don't use generic SaaS landing patterns: 'Ship faster' headlines, three-card feature rows, frosted-glass hero panels.
Don't apply transform: translateY(-Xpx) to cards or rows on hover. A horizontal nudge on a chevron or arrow is the only permitted movement.
Don't let any surface cast a shadow or glow at rest. Shadows and glows are state responses — hover, focus, float — not decoration.
